map.如何使用温度缩放 Logits？: How do I use Temperature-Scaled Logits?
map.温度缩放 Logits适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Temperature-Scaled Logits best for?
map.演示 softmax 前对 logits 做温度缩放。: Demonstrates temperature scaling of logits before softmax.
map.z′ = z/T（T>1 平滑分布，T<1 锐化分布）: z' = z/T (T>1 smooths the distribution, T<1 sharpens it)
map.对 logits 统一除以温度是最简单的概率校准手段，T 在验证集上用 NLL: Dividing logits uniformly by a temperature is the simplest probability calibration; T is found on the validation set by minimizing NLL. It does not change the argmax, so accuracy is unaffected, only the reliability of confidence (ECE) improves. It can only correct overall over/under-confidence, not per-class bias.
map.scaled = logit / T；T>1 更平滑，T<1 更尖锐: scaled = logit / T; T>1 smoother, T<1 sharper
map.仅用于演示 softmax 前缩放，不改变 argmax。: Only for demonstrating pre-softmax scaling; does not change the argmax.
map.在 softmax 前对 logits 做 z/T，演示温度对概率形态的影响，不: Applying z/T to logits before softmax shows how temperature shapes the probability distribution, without changing the argmax.
map.T>1 平滑分布(置信度降低)，T<1 锐化(更自信)，是模型校准常用手段。: T>1 smooths the distribution (lower confidence), T<1 sharpens it (more confident); a common model-calibration technique.
map.与生成温度同源：同一机制既可用于校准也可调生成多样性。: Shares the same mechanism as generation temperature: one mechanism serves both calibration and tuning generation diversity.
map.logits=[3,1,0]，T=1 → 概率≈[0.8438,0.1142,0: logits=[3,1,0], T=1 -> prob ~[0.8438,0.1142,0.0420]; T=2 -> [0.6285,0.2312,0.1402], the max probability drops from 84.38% to 62.85%, closer to true accuracy and thus calibrated; T=0.5 -> [0.9796,0.0179,0.0024] overconfident. Note scaling only changes magnitudes, argmax stays class 1.
map.(argmax 不变)，只让输出置信度更'诚实'地反映正确率，对需要可靠概率的应: (argmax unchanged), it only makes the output confidence more 'honest' about the true accuracy, valuable for applications needing reliable probabilities (e.g. risk decisions).
map.T 用什么值校准？: What T value is used for calibration?
map.在验证集上用负对数似然最小化搜索最优 T(通常略大于 1)，使预测置信度与经验准: On the validation set, search for the optimal T by minimizing negative log-likelihood (usually slightly above 1) so predicted confidence aligns with empirical accuracy; it is post-processing and does not change model weights.
